data.title: Climb Bio Highlights Promising Phase 1 IgA Therapy Data
data.description:
Climb Bio ( (CLYM) ) has shared an announcement.

On October 23, 2026, Climb Bio and Beijing Mabworks reported additional Phase 1 data in healthy volunteers for CLYM116/MIL116, an anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody in development for IgA nephropathy, presented at ASN Kidney Week 2026 in Denver. The drug’s novel “sweeper” design aims to clear APRIL while recycling the antibody, supporting deep APRIL suppression with extended dosing intervals in complementary trials run in Australia and China.

The new results showed an estimated ~33-day half-life, sustained ≥90% free APRIL suppression over 12 weeks at doses of 480 mg or higher, and around 70% reduction in galactose-deficient IgA1 plus 60% reduction in IgA at 12 weeks with a single 800 mg subcutaneous dose, with consistent pharmacokinetics across studies and no serious safety signals. These data underpin a potential every-12-week dosing regimen now being tested in the NAVIGATE-2 Phase 2 IgA nephropathy trial and position CLYM116/MIL116 as a potentially best-in-class anti-APRIL therapy, reinforcing the Climb–Mabworks partnership as they advance toward a planned global Phase 3 program, a development that could be significant for patients given the persistent unmet need in IgA nephropathy.
